title: Consider a provider-neutral launcher for host-installed Engram MCP servers
outcome: Evaluate a provider-neutral host launcher that preserves explicit Engram project/home/actor/session/store authority while placing provider-installed MCP processes outside the session worktree. Any implementation remains separate from the delegated-child cleanup item's termination guarantee.
acceptance: Consider a provider-neutral launcher for host-installed Engram MCP servers is done
